english.title: Fly non UK registered aeroplane at night / in reduced visibility / when cloud ceiling less than 1,000 feet
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the

(A)_[operator]_
(B)_[pilot in command]_

of an aeroplane which was registered elsewhere than in the United Kingdom, powered by one power unit only, and flying on

(C)_[an A to A commercial air transport aeroplane operation]_
(D)_[a public transport flight]_

and which flew

(E)_[at night.]_
(F)_[when there was prevailing at the aerodrome of departure, namely **(..SPECIFY AERODROME..) a cloud ceiling of less than 1,000 feet]_
(G)_[when there was prevailing at the aerodrome of departure, namely **(..SPECIFY AERODROME..) visibility of less than one nautical mile]_
(H)_[when there was forecast for the estimated time of landing at the aerodrome at which it was intended to land, namely **(..SPECIFY AERODROME..) or at any destination alternate aerodrome a cloud ceiling of less than 1,000 feet]_
(I)_[when there was forecast for the estimated time of landing at the aerodrome at which it was intended to land, namely **(..SPECIFY AERODROME..) or at any destination alternate aerodrome visibility of less than one nautical mile]_
(J)_[when there was prevailing at the aerodrome of departure, namely **(..SPECIFY AERODROME..) a cloud ceiling of less than 1,000 feet and visibility of less than one nautical mile]_
(K)_[when there was forecast for the estimated time of landing at the aerodrome at which it was intended to land, namely **(..SPECIFY AERODROME..) or at any destination alternate aerodrome a cloud ceiling of less than 1,000 feet and visibility of less than one nautical mile]_
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 133 and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
were the operator or pilot in command of an aeroplane
registered elsewhere than in the United Kingdom
powered by one power unit only and flying on an A to A commercial air transport aeroplane operation or a public transport flight
which flew
at night OR
when there was prevailing at the aerodrome of departure, a cloud ceiling of less than 1,000 feet OR
when there was prevailing at the aerodrome of departure, visibility of less than one nautical mile OR
when there was forecast for the estimated time of landing at the aerodrome at which it was intended to land, or at any destination alternate aerodrome a cloud ceiling of less than 1,000 feet OR
when there was forecast for the estimated time of landing at the aerodrome at which it was intended to land, or at any destination alternate aerodrome visibility of less than one nautical mile OR
when there was prevailing at the aerodrome of departure, a cloud ceiling of less than 1,000 feet and visibility of less than one nautical mile OR
when there was forecast for the estimated time of landing at the aerodrome at which it was intended to land or at any destination alternate aerodrome, a cloud ceiling of less than 1,000 feet and visibility of less than one nautical mile OR
